record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.original_question: Show that μ_φ satisfies the large deviation principle for Hölder continuous observables with zero μ_φ-average that are not coboundaries.

evidence.quote: Problem 6. — Show that µϕ satisfies the Large Deviation Principle (LDP) for Hölder continuous observables.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f:\mathbb{C}^2	o\mathbb{C}^2$ be a complex Hénon map, i.e. a finite composition of generalized Hénon maps of the form $(x,y)\mapsto(p(x)-ay,x)$ with $p$ a polynomial of degree $\ge 2$ and $a\in\mathbb{C}^*$. Let $\varphi$ be a Hölder continuous potential on $\mathbb{C}^2$ (subject to standard admissibility conditions ensuring the existence of a unique equilibrium state of $f$ with respect to $\varphi$), and let $\mu_\varphi$ denote this unique equilibrium state, which is an $f$-invariant probability measure maximizing the variational principle $h_
u(f)+\int\varphi\,d
u$ among $f$-invariant probability measures $
u$.

For a continuous observable $\psi$ and $n\ge 1$, write $S_n\psi=\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}\psi\circ f^k$. The measure $\mu_\varphi$ is said to satisfy the Large Deviation Principle for $\psi$ if there exists a lower semicontinuous rate function $I_\psi:\mathbb{R}	o[0,+\infty]$ such that, for every Borel set $E\subset\mathbb{R}$,
$$-\inf_{t\in\mathrm{int}(E)} I_\psi(t)\;\le\;\liminf_{n	o\infty}	frac{1}{n}\log\mu_\varphi\!\left(	frac{1}{n}S_n\psi\in Eight)\;\le\;\limsup_{n	o\infty}	frac{1}{n}\log\mu_\varphi\!\left(	frac{1}{n}S_n\psi\in Eight)\;\le\;-\inf_{t\in\overline{E}} I_\psi(t),$$
with $I_\psi$ vanishing only at $t=\int\psi\,d\mu_\varphi$.

Recall that a continuous function $\psi$ is called a coboundary (over $f$) in a class $\mathcal{C}$ if there exists $u\in\mathcal{C}$ such that $\psi=u\circ f-u$.

Problem. Prove that for every Hölder continuous observable $\psi$ satisfying $\int\psi\,d\mu_\varphi=0$ and not equal to a (continuous) coboundary over $f$, the equilibrium state $\mu_\varphi$ satisfies the Large Deviation Principle for $\psi$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is listed as an open problem in a recent compilation of open problems on Hénon maps (2023/2024). Large deviation principles have been proved in related settings (one-dimensional maps, rational maps, the Katok map, Viana maps), but no result establishing the LDP for equilibrium states of Hölder potentials of complex Hénon maps appears in the literature. The problem appears to still be open.

status_evidence.title: Unique equilibrium states, large deviations and Lyapunov spectra for the Katok Map
status_evidence.snippet: LDP established for the Katok map, not for Hénon maps.
status_evidence.claim: LDP for equilibrium states is known in related non-uniformly hyperbolic settings but not for Hénon.

status_evidence.title: Large deviation principles for non-uniformly hyperbolic rational maps
status_evidence.snippet: LDP shown for non-uniformly hyperbolic rational maps in one complex variable.
status_evidence.claim: Analogous LDP results exist in one-dimensional complex dynamics, suggesting the Hénon case remains to be done.
